# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Read in order: `AGENTS.md`, `docs/process/WORKFLOW.md`, `skills.json`, `agents.json`, `prompts.json`, applicable `.agent/skills/**/SKILL.md`, approved requirements, design, tasks, `HANDOFF.md`, and `decisions.md`.

Inspect before editing. Follow approved scope and do not expose secrets. Use communication skills for written output. Do not commit or push. Run applicable validation and report changed files, requirement coverage, tests and results, assumptions, risks, and warnings. Product and agent capabilities depend on the active Copilot/VS Code configuration.
